Preview which assets and enemies one session places. Some maps pick a variation per session (the small bases, the Nightlord arenas), and a random slot from 0 to 99 is drawn each session for the map objects with a Random Appear Param. Map objects that the chosen session leaves out are hidden or ghosted. This only changes the view: nothing is saved.
